parameters.content:
## 1. INPUT
Form -> settings -> read your CSV -> clean rows (columns matched loosely, duplicates removed).

## 2. AI DRAFTING
Groq (Llama) writes one comment + one email per row. Key is read from .env. Calls retry 3x; one failure never stops the run.

## 3. QUALITY + SAVE
Auto-checks (length, links, spam words, invented numbers, leftover placeholders), priority scoring, then save drafts.

## 4. HUMAN REVIEW (required)
Nothing is exported until you approve. Only rows with status = draft go to outreach_approved.csv.
